description: This file declares functions and types related to generating HMAC signatures using TPM (Trusted Platform Module) resources, including functions for HMAC with a key handle and with a specific context, along with associated resource management utilities.

classes.name: EsysDeleter
classes.description: A functor for freeing TPM2B_DIGEST structures using Esys_Free.

methods.name: TpmHmac
methods.description: Generates an HMAC signature for the provided data using a TPM key handle, ensuring data integrity and authenticity.

methods.name: TpmHmacWithContext
methods.description: Generates an HMAC signature for the provided data using a TPM key associated with a specific context string.
